OpenChemLib JS 9.25.1 (openchemlib), a cheminformatics library: SMILES and
molfile parse and write, 2D coordinate generation, stereo perception, ring
and aromaticity perception, molecule properties, 3D conformer generation and
the MMFF94 force field. By cheminfo and Idorsia Pharmaceuticals (the Java
OpenChemLib, compiled to JavaScript with GWT). BSD 3-Clause licence: see
LICENSE in this folder.

Source:    https://registry.npmjs.org/openchemlib/-/openchemlib-9.25.1.tgz

           LICENSE                 from the tarball
Build:     the minified ES module bundle (no imports, no WASM). It runs in
           the browser and in Node. The conformer generator and the MMFF94
           force field need resources.json: call
           Resources.registerFromUrl(<url of dist/resources.json>) in the
           browser, or Resources.register(<file text>) in Node, before use.
Not kept:  dist/openchemlib.debug.js (the unminified bundle), the types
           (dist/openchemlib.d.ts) and the README.
Users:     stella-nova/pages/molecules (engine.js loads it on demand; the
           library build and tests.mjs load it in Node).
